description: An opinion about the value of a specific OpenStreetMap field on an element (node, way, or relation)

subject.description: The OpenStreetMap element (node, way, or relation) the opinion is about

field.description: The OpenStreetMap key the opinion is about, e.g. 'climbing:grade:uiaa' or 'name'

value.description: The value the author believes the field should have, e.g. '6b+' for a grade opinion

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the opinion was posted
